title: Microsoft Copilot: Copilot edits on a Page are highlighted by default
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents preview automation for the Pages creation policy, contrary to the table's claim that none is documented. The briefing also overstates where all Pages are stored and incorrectly describes the creation policy as the only documented control in this area.

claims.claim: The creation control is in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center at Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization ... Select Policy Management ... Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one ... Choose the scope ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.claim: No API or automation for the Pages and Notebooks creation control is documented.
claims.quote: The 20 Copilot resources are Office Cloud Policy Service (OCPS) settings. TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].api.kind to 'graph', call to 'POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors', and docs to 'https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta'. Add to its note: 'Preview TCM automation uses mode=applyOnce and an inline baseline resource of type microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion 1, with properties.value set to the string "0" to disable or "1" to enable. It supports tenant-level policies only and fails if this setting is configured in a group-level policy. It requires delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All for the calling app, delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite for the TCM service principal, and AI Administrator for the signed-in user.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources as well.
